user.title: Add ONVIF Camera
user.description: Connect a camera using its ONVIF service address and credentials.

init.title: Bitrate limits
init.description: Automatic detection uses ONVIF Media2. If unavailable, enter confirmed bitrate limits for this camera. Set both fields to 0 for automatic detection. These limits apply to each H.264 encoder on this camera.

error.invalid_bitrate_range: Enter two zeros or a valid positive min/max range
